entities.summary: Edward C. Gayda was an American professional basketball player. Gayda was selected in the second round of the 1950 NBA draft by the Tri-Cities Blackhawks after a collegiate career at Washington State. He played for the Blackhawks in 15 total games in 1951–52. In 2014, he was inducted into the Pac-12 Hall of Honor.
